claw-helper v1.0.0

- Initial release of OpenClaw 助手 skill.
- Answers OpenClaw usage, configuration, and troubleshooting questions.
- All configuration changes must use the CLI: openclaw config set.
- Prioritizes using local documentation to answer queries.
- Records reliable solutions in the reference experience file.
- Maintains and updates local documentation index as needed.
